description: Use this when the user wants to change a class of one of their funds: its name, commitment limits, unit price, fees or admin fee reserve. Starts the change to the terms they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_edit_fund_class
title: Edit a fund class’s terms
